excerpts_manually_approved_50_to_100.detail: 51 approved of 258 proposed. Requires a person: §27 forbids presenting automatically selected excerpts as human approved. Run `python -m fugue_data.review.app`.

reviewed_pairs_at_least_500.detail: 561 reviewed of 7123 candidates. Requires a person: §18.6 forbids exporting an unreviewed pair.

wtc1_annotations_aligned.detail: 23 of 24; fugue 11 (BWV 856) has no upstream structural analysis -- documented override, not fabricated coverage

constraint_critic.note: Matched parents: every negative names the valid sample it came from.

feasibility.note: Hard-valid real and synthetic material with rule-profile metadata.

preferences.note: Only reviewed pairs are exported (§18.6). Unreviewed candidates are excluded, so an empty export means labelling has not happened yet, not that no candidates exist.

style.note: Real Bach movements plus human-approved excerpts only. Pending excerpts are excluded: §27 forbids presenting automatically selected material as human approved.

preferences.note: Agent labels do not count toward §18.6, which requires human review. They are recorded separately so the two kinds of evidence are never conflated.
